original_clauses.source_paraphrase: In tests of Grok Build v0.2.93, a researcher captured the CLI sending a Git bundle with tracked files and repository history to xAI storage even when the task asked only for “OK” and the agent was not asked to inspect repository files.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Task authority to inspect selected repository content does not itself authorise transmitting the whole repository and its history to a separate storage service; the scope and destination of that action must remain within the granted authority.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The CLI sent tracked files beyond those the bounded coding task needed or the agent read, so task-local permission was extended to repository-wide storage transfer in the observed implementation.

original_clauses.source_paraphrase: The researcher later observed that xAI had disabled the upload server-side on the tested account; the observation did not establish the scope or permanence of the change across accounts.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Containment claims should identify the affected deployment scope and be bounded by observed verification; a change on one tested account does not establish fleet-wide remediation.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: The researcher used fake credentials and captured file contents in model-turn requests and session archives after file reads.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Synthetic probes show observed transmission, not real-customer secret loss.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: In separate tests, the CLI uploaded tracked files and Git history even when told not to open files. Unread canaries were recovered from uploaded bundles on two repositories.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Task-local access does not itself authorise independent repository-wide storage.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The CLI sent tracked files beyond those the bounded coding task needed or the agent read, so task-local permission was extended to repository-wide storage transfer in the observed implementation.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: A larger test captured 5.10 GiB before being stopped. Storage accepted uploads despite model quota errors. Turning off model improvement did not stop bundle transmission.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Storage transfer, model processing and training preferences are separate pathways.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: The researcher retracted an earlier inference that large transfers failed locally. Process-scoped network measurement had missed the separate uploader.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A corrected observation supersedes an incomplete measurement.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: The researcher later observed server-side upload disablement on the tested account. A separately tested privacy option governed retention; promised deletion was unconfirmed.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Observed containment must retain its account scope and distinguish transmission from retention.
